name: relgap
short: Release-notes digests and toolchain drift for the tools you pin

children.name: audit
children.short: List the known vulnerabilities of every pinned tool version, and the pins OSV can't check

children.name: cache
children.short: Inspect or clear the HTTP cache

children.name: clear
children.short: Delete every cache entry

children.name: info
children.short: Show the cache directory, entry count, size and freshness

children.name: prune
children.short: Delete entries not used for a while

children.name: completion
children.short: Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell

children.name: config
children.short: Inspect and validate configuration

children.name: init
children.short: Write a commented config file

children.name: path
children.short: Print the config file locations relgap reads

children.name: show
children.short: Print the effective configuration

children.name: validate
children.short: Validate config files against the schema

children.name: digest
children.short: Merge the release notes of every version in a range into one digest

children.name: drift
children.short: Show which repositories pin different versions of the same tool

children.name: mcp
children.short: Serve digest, breaking_changes, outdated, drift and resolve to an MCP client over stdio

children.name: notify
children.short: Publish saved digest, outdated and drift reports as a GitHub pull request comment

children.name: outdated
children.short: Compare every pinned tool version in a project with the latest release

children.name: pins
children.short: List the tool versions pinned in your repositories, with file and line

children.name: registry
children.short: Check, test and update relgap registry entries

children.name: lint
children.short: Validate registry entries against the schema

children.name: test
children.short: Run each source of a registry entry live and show what it produced

children.name: update
children.short: Download the newest registry entries from relgap's repository

children.name: resolve
children.short: Show how a tool name resolves to a repository, version rules and changelog sources

children.name: version
children.short: Print version and build information
